name: Gobbler Cube Day 2017

venue.name: [Graduate Life Center Multipurpose Room at Virginia Tech](http://www.catering.vt.edu/services/glc-multi-purpose-room)

information: Registration will cost $15 and must be completed online. At-the-door registration will not be allowed. Free for VT students, faculty, staff, and alumni. There is an 80 person competitor limit. Please read the "Competitor Information" tab before registering.
